tenderSchedule.title: Supply of Breakfast
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Breakfast to Pourakarmikas/Sanitation Staff in CMC Kolar

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid.
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP Portal.
Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only. More details should be collected from the office at working hours
Break fast to be supplied daily between 8 am -9 am at specified place
All terms and conditions as per tender document
Bidder has to quote rates including Break fast with BOILED EGG

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have supplied food/breakfast for Pourkarmikas in any ULBs/other government departments for a period of atleast one year. during 2021-22 to 2025-26 Mentioning the Tender Notification and E-Tender Number and work order copy.

Tenderer should have annual turnover of at least an amount equal to the estimated cost i.e. 32.00 lakhs during any two of the last five Financial Year i.e. from 2021-22 to 2025-26 The Tenderer should submit copy certified by Chartered Accountant

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
